name: event_detector_portfolio_fresh_cusip_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1626: PORTFOLIO_FRESH_NEEDED fired on three holdings stored as CUSIPs. The broker returns the
CUSIP as the symbol when a position has no active ticker, and holdings.json keeps those rows;
watchlist_agent_results is keyed by ticker, so no analysis of them can exist, their event can never
clear, and each run spent one of its three fires on an identifier. A never-analyzed CUSIP sorts first
(the None sentinel) and therefore crowded a genuinely stale holding out of the cap. Pins: the CUSIP is
never fired and never named, only counted in one line; the three real holdings behind it all fire; the
denominator is holdings, not identifiers; a book of only CUSIPs reports the skip count and then no
holdings; and the shared predicate (security_identity.is_cusip_like) does not mistake a digit-bearing
ticker or a nine-letter name for a CUSIP. Synthetic ZQ* fixtures; no store is read.
